name: Soren Variation Swatches
author: 10nstudio

sections.description:
A dropdown asks your customer to read a colour name and hope for the best. Swatches show the real thing: the fabric, the paint, the finish. Soren Variation Swatches replaces every WooCommerce variation select with clean, clickable swatches that look like part of your theme and work with a keyboard.

Built for real stores, not demos: swatches are rendered on the server, archive data is cached, assets load only where they are needed, and out-of-stock variations stay visible and honest instead of quietly disappearing.

Everything on this page is free

No watermark, no account, no external request, no variation limit. Every swatch type, style, layout, stock state and admin tool described on this page ships in this plugin. An optional Pro add-on is a separate plugin that adds different styles; this plugin contains none of its code and works fully without it.

At a glance

  • Six swatch types: colour, dual colour (split chip), image, label, radio and image + label.
  • Six styles and three layouts, chosen from the settings screen, not from CSS.
  • Product pages, shop and category archives, quick view popups and cart line items.
  • Per-product overrides, product-level attributes and a bulk value editor.
  • A real accessible radio group: keyboard navigation, focus ring, 44px tap targets.
  • No jQuery on the frontend, no external HTTP calls, no tracking, no account.
  • One-click import from Variation Swatches, ThemeHigh, YITH WooCommerce Swatches and WooCommerce core data.
  • Classic themes, block themes, page builders and HPOS: all supported.

Why swatches sell

A colour name is a label; a colour chip is the product. When a shopper can see the actual finish, fabric or flavour, they stop guessing, compare faster and add to cart with more confidence. That is the whole idea behind this plugin: show the option, do not describe it.

It matters most where the choice is visual: apparel and footwear, paint and finishes, fabric and wallpaper, cosmetics, coffee and tea, furniture, phone cases, and anything with more than three variants.

One swatch, six ways

  • Colour: a solid chip from a hex value, with an optional tooltip label.
  • Dual colour: two colours split across one chip for two-tone products.
  • Image: any media library image, cropped to a dedicated 96px size with srcset.
  • Label: short text such as S, M, L, XL or 128GB, sized to the content.
  • Radio: a compact, high-contrast dot for binary or small option sets.
  • Image + label: the thumbnail and the name together, for photographic catalogues.

Type is set per attribute, with an automatic mode that picks the right one from the data you already have. Any attribute can be reverted to the native dropdown, and a single product can override the global choice.

Everywhere your customers look

  • Product pages, including WooCommerce blocks and quick view popups.
  • Archives: shop, category, tag and search results, under every variable product.
  • Cart line items: the chosen colour or image appears next to the variation name.
  • Per-product overrides, so one hero product can look different from the rest.
  • Linked archive swatches: the value travels in the link, so the product page opens with it already selected.
  • Bulk value editor: fill colour, image, label and tooltip for many values on one screen.
  • Product-level attributes, not just global ones.

Design control without a page builder

  • Six styles: circle, soft square, sharp square, pill, outline and text chip.
  • Three layouts: inline, grid and label above.
  • Size, spacing, radius, border width, typography, alignment and every state colour.
  • Tooltips with three modes: value name, attribute label, or variation price.
  • A live preview in the settings screen shows the result before you save.
  • Everything is exposed as a CSS variable, so a theme or child theme can restyle swatches without a fork.

Accessible by construction

  • A real fieldset with native radio inputs, not clickable divs.
  • Arrow key navigation, a visible focus ring and 44px tap targets.
  • Screen readers announce the attribute, the value and whether it is unavailable.
  • Out-of-stock values are never removed silently, and colour is never the only signal.
  • The original WooCommerce select stays in the page, so nothing depends on JavaScript alone.

Fast on purpose

  • Server-rendered markup, one small stylesheet and one small script.
  • Conditional loading: nothing is added to pages without swatches.
  • A single cached payload per archive page, invalidated when products change.
  • No jQuery on the frontend, no external HTTP calls, no tracking.
  • Images ship a dedicated size, srcset, width and height to cut bytes and layout shift.

Your data stays yours

  • Colours and images live in standard WooCommerce term meta, so deactivating the plugin leaves your catalogue intact.
  • One-click import from Variation Swatches (GetWooPlugins), ThemeHigh, YITH WooCommerce Swatches and WooCommerce core attributes.
  • Auto-detect import for plugins that store term colours or images in their own meta keys.
  • Uninstall removes settings and term data only if you explicitly enable “delete data”.
  • HPOS (custom order tables) declared compatible.

Free and Pro

Everything listed above is in this plugin. A separate Pro add-on is available for stores that want more: additional swatch styles, and its own settings screen. It is a different plugin, it is not required here, and nothing in this plugin is locked, limited or time-restricted.

Built to be extended

  • Filters for settings, swatch data and rendered HTML, including soren_swatches_attribute_options, soren_swatches_option_disabled, soren_swatches_chip_html, soren_swatches_styles, soren_swatches_color_palette and the archive cache filters.
  • Attribute value meta exposed to REST for headless storefronts.
  • WP-CLI: wp soren-swatches import and wp soren-swatches flush.
  • Namespaced classes, no unguarded global functions, translation ready and RTL ready.

Who it is for

Store owners who sell variations and want the product page to look like the product. Developers who want a swatch layer with hooks instead of a page builder dependency. Agencies that need one plugin to behave the same on classic and block themes, with no external service to explain to a client.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or newer.
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or newer.
  • PHP 8.0 or newer.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Products → Attributes, edit an attribute value and set a colour or an image.
  4. Open Soren → Variation Swatches and choose the swatch type for that attribute.
sections.faq:
Does it work with my theme?

Swatches use standard WooCommerce hooks and keep the original select in the page, so they work with classic themes, block themes and page builders. An optional “Force styles” setting is available for themes that override swatch styling aggressively.

Will it slow down my shop?

No. Assets load only on pages that need them, archive data is cached per product, and swatch markup is rendered server side. There is no external service call at any point. Large catalogues can clear the cache with wp soren-swatches flush.

Can I use swatches on product-level attributes?

Yes. Global attributes are configured once, and product-level attributes can be configured from the product edit screen.

What happens to out-of-stock variations?

They stay visible, are marked with the treatment you choose (cross out, blur, fade or hide) and are announced to assistive technology as unavailable.

Does it work with the WooCommerce color swatches introduced in version 10.9?

Yes. Core visual attributes (wc-visual) only render inside block themes and behind a feature toggle. Soren reads the same colour and image data as a fallback and also works on classic themes, so both can be used side by side.

Can I migrate from another swatch plugin?

Yes. Soren → Variation Swatches → Tools imports colours and images from Variation Swatches (GetWooPlugins), ThemeHigh and YITH WooCommerce Swatches, and reads WooCommerce core attribute data. Importing is non-destructive: nothing is deleted from the other plugin.

Do I need the Pro plugin?

No. The free plugin is complete on its own: every swatch type, style, layout, stock state and admin tool on this page is included. Pro is a separate add-on for extra styles.

Can I change the look without writing CSS?

Yes, size, spacing, radius, borders, colours and typography are all settings with a live preview. If you do want code, every visual token is a CSS variable that your theme can override.

Is it translation ready?

Yes. All strings use the plugin text domain, a POT file ships in /languages, and the interface and styles work in RTL languages as well as LTR.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • New: one-click colour palette in the attribute term editor, grouped into neutrals, earth, fashion and bold.
  • New: palette colours can be filtered with the soren_swatches_color_palette hook.

1.2.1

  • Added the soren_swatches_attribute_options filter so add-ons can remove values per product.
  • Added the soren_swatches_option_disabled filter and a disabled state for swatch inputs.
  • Added the soren_swatches_groups_cacheable filter for add-ons whose output depends on the visitor.

1.2.0

  • New Styles tab: preview every free style and see which Pro styles exist, with no locked code in this plugin.
  • Added the soren_swatches_styles filter so add-ons can register their own styles.
  • Added the soren_swatches_chip_html filter for add-ons that extend the chip markup.
  • Variation images are now available to chip filters on the product page.

1.1.1

  • Removed the custom CSS field; every visual token is already a CSS variable you can restyle from your theme.
  • Escaped term field markup when it is printed, instead of ignoring the check.

1.1.0

  • Archive swatches link to their value, so the product page preselects that variation.
  • The {price} tooltip placeholder now prints the lowest price of the matching variations.
  • Image swatches ship a dedicated 96px size, srcset and width/height to cut bytes and layout shift.
  • Text swatches take their value colour, with automatic label contrast.
  • New bulk action fills swatch colours from value names, in English and Persian.
  • New bulk value editor at Soren -> Swatch Values for colour, image, label and tooltip.
  • Attribute value meta is exposed to REST for headless storefronts.
  • WP-CLI: wp soren-swatches import and wp soren-swatches flush.

1.0.0

  • First release.
  • Colour, dual colour, image, label, radio and image + label swatches.
  • Six visual styles and three layouts.
  • Product page, archive and cart display.
  • Per-product overrides and product-level attributes.
  • Accessible radio group foundation with keyboard and screen reader support.
  • Cached archive payloads and conditional asset loading.
  • Importer for other swatch plugins and WooCommerce core data.
